findings.problem: This is the main drag on the writing score. The Washington section (four dense paragraphs) carries legal chronology in long, clause-stacked sentences like this one, and paragraph two packs the apology, court line, suit, two designations, two rulings and current status into four sentences. Across the back half the verdict recurs in one frame ("What leans Six is ...", "What leans Six is how much of his footing ...", "The case for Six is that ...", "The Six reading leans instead on ..."), so sections end by restating the lean rather than on their own new fact.
